dependency: R5-P0-040 and R5-P0-090 accepted; P0-070/090 accepted in B01-AI. Original-scale P0-100 execution and independent evidence review remain pending.

L.release_necessity: P0 requires actual S and M only; L 10M dataset and budget are frozen but not executed or capacity-certified here. P10/final release claiming 10M must execute L and retain actual evidence.

population.historical_personal_permanent: never reinterpret anomalous expiry as shared finite retention

measurement_scope: Real shipping API/PostgreSQL/filesystem objects; tool-only small contract validation is not any original-scale baseline
message_size_generation: Each seeded block of 1000 has exact 800/180/19/1 bucket counts, shuffled deterministically using seed3893945; real SQL size histogram must equal contract.
lifecycle_generation: Each block of20 creates16 inbox/2 archived/1 trash-expired/1 hard-expired; the hard-expired slot must select a shared mailbox. Tenant80/20 is assigned across blocks, not the single ordinal that would put all expired messages in the foreign tenant.

distribution_validation.source: actual PostgreSQL catalog and row counts, not model parameter echo
distribution_validation.employee_and_mailbox_counts: original scale exact; one personal and four shared per employee
distribution_validation.shared_grants: four distinct legal grantees per shared mailbox
distribution_validation.message_lifecycle_counts: exact 80/10/5/5 of generated messages, with no hard-expired personal mailbox reinterpretation
distribution_validation.mime_size_counts: actual messages.size grouped by bucket, source-byte lengths and parsed source hashes
distribution_validation.index_ready_count: actual durable mail_documents for every seeded message

fingerprints.parameter_fingerprint: Separate SHA256 of frozen generator parameters; not the dataset observation hash
fingerprints.dataset_fingerprint: Stream SHA256 over actual canonical rows ordered by message identity: messageID, tenantName, mailboxAddress, raw key, size, actual lifecycle, durable sourceSHA256 and parserVersion; no payload/credential values are archived

sql_plan_requirement: At least one representative SQL captured from a real shipping request by the actual tracer, executed with identical bound parameters through EXPLAIN FORMAT JSON; record query/parameter digests, plan, source/schema/scale/index-ready provenance, not raw parameters.
resource_unknown_policy: Unavailable/zero RSS or disk walk/database-size errors reject the evidence; never substitute zero as a measured value.

tool_only_dataset_calibration.purpose: real SQL/API/filesystem/index distribution and fingerprint/EXPLAIN calibration only; four foreign employees permit four distinct legal grants
